Method.name: CountAll
Method.Description: Count messages across ALL namespaces in the instance for a time window. pStart/pEnd can be $H ("day,seconds") or timestamp string ("YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS").
Method.Implementation:
Set total=0 Set startTS=..NormTS(pStart) Set endTS=..NormTS(pEnd)
Kill nsList Do ##class(%SYS.Namespace).ListAll(.nsList)
Set ns="" For { Set ns=$Order(nsList(ns)) Quit:ns="" Continue:$Extract(ns,1,1)="%"
Set status="" Set total = total + ..CountOneNamespace(ns,startTS,endTS,.status) }
Quit total

Method.name: DebugAll
Method.Description: Debug helper: prints per-namespace counts for a window.
Method.Implementation:
Set total=0 Set startTS=..NormTS(pStart) Set endTS=..NormTS(pEnd)
Kill nsList Do ##class(%SYS.Namespace).ListAll(.nsList)
Write !,"MessageCounter DebugAll",! Write "StartTS=",startTS,! Write "EndTS =",endTS,!! Write "Namespace",?18,"Count",?30,"Status",!
Set ns="" For { Set ns=$Order(nsList(ns)) Quit:ns="" Continue:$Extract(ns,1,1)="%"
Set status="" Set c=..CountOneNamespace(ns,startTS,endTS,.status) Write ns,?18,c,?30,status,! Set total=total+c }
Write !,"TOTAL=",total,!! Quit total

Method.name: CountNamespace
Method.Description: Count messages in ONE namespace for a time window.
Method.Implementation: Set startTS=..NormTS(pStart) Set endTS=..NormTS(pEnd) Set status="" Quit ..CountOneNamespace(pNamespace,startTS,endTS,.status)

Method.name: PrintSummaryTable
Method.Description: Human readable “as of now” table: DAY/WTD/MTD per namespace + totals. pNow can be "" (now), $H, or "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"
Method.Implementation:
If pNow="" Set pNow=$ZDATETIME($HOROLOG,3)
Set h=..ToHorolog(pNow) Set ts=..NormTS(pNow)
; ---- windows (to-date) ---- Set dayStart=$Piece(h,",",1)_",0" Set dayEnd=h
; WTD: Monday -> now Set dow=$SYSTEM.SQL.DAYOFWEEK(h) ; 1=Sun..7=Sat Set offset=(dow+5)#7 ; Mon offset: Sun->6, Mon->0, Tue->1... Set startDay=$Piece(h,",",1)-offset Set wtdStart=startDay_",0" Set wtdEnd=h
; MTD: 1st -> now Set year=+$Extract(ts,1,4) Set mon=+$Extract(ts,6,7) Set mon2=..Pad2(mon) Set firstStr=year_"-"_mon2_"-01 00:00:00" Set mtdStart=$ZDATETIMEH(firstStr,3) Set mtdEnd=h
; ---- compute per-namespace counts for each window ---- Kill dayCounts,dayExcl,wtdCounts,wtdExcl,mtdCounts,mtdExcl Set dayTotal=0,wtdTotal=0,mtdTotal=0
Do ..BuildWindowCounts(dayStart,dayEnd,.dayCounts,.dayExcl,.dayTotal) Do ..BuildWindowCounts(wtdStart,wtdEnd,.wtdCounts,.wtdExcl,.wtdTotal) Do ..BuildWindowCounts(mtdStart,mtdEnd,.mtdCounts,.mtdExcl,.mtdTotal)
; ---- union namespace keys ---- Kill seen Set n=""
Set n="" For { Set n=$Order(dayCounts(n)) Quit:n="" Set seen(n)="" } Set n="" For { Set n=$Order(wtdCounts(n)) Quit:n="" Set seen(n)="" } Set n="" For { Set n=$Order(mtdCounts(n)) Quit:n="" Set seen(n)="" }
; ---- print ---- Write !!,"Message Summary (as of ",ts,")",! Write "Namespace",?25,"DAY",?40,"WTD",?55,"MTD",!
Set ns="" For { Set ns=$Order(seen(ns)) Quit:ns="" Write ns Write ?25,+$Get(dayCounts(ns)) Write ?40,+$Get(wtdCounts(ns)) Write ?55,+$Get(mtdCounts(ns)) Write ! }
Write !,"TOTAL" Write ?25,dayTotal Write ?40,wtdTotal Write ?55,mtdTotal,!!
Quit

Method.name: GetSummaryJSON
Method.Implementation:
If pNow="" Set pNow=$ZDATETIME($HOROLOG,3) Set h=..ToHorolog(pNow) Set ts=..NormTS(pNow)
; day-to-date Set dayStart=$Piece(h,",",1)_",0" Set day=..CountAll(dayStart,h)
; wtd (Mon -> now) Set dow=$SYSTEM.SQL.DAYOFWEEK(h) Set offset=(dow+5)#7 Set startDay=$Piece(h,",",1)-offset Set wtdStart=startDay_",0" Set wtd=..CountAll(wtdStart,h)
; mtd (1st -> now) Set year=+$Extract(ts,1,4) Set mon=+$Extract(ts,6,7) Set mon2=..Pad2(mon) Set firstStr=year_"-"_mon2_"-01 00:00:00" Set mtdStart=$ZDATETIMEH(firstStr,3) Set mtd=..CountAll(mtdStart,h)
Quit "{""as_of"":"""_..JsonEsc(ts)_""",""day_to_date"":"_day_",""week_to_date"":"_wtd_",""month_to_date"":"_mtd_"}"

Method.name: GetSummaryJSONByNamespace
Method.Description: JSON summary by namespace (to-date) with totals + exclusions.
Method.Implementation:
If pNow="" Set pNow=$ZDATETIME($HOROLOG,3)
Set h=..ToHorolog(pNow) Set ts=..NormTS(pNow)
; windows Set dayStart=$Piece(h,",",1)_",0" Set dayEnd=h
Set dow=$SYSTEM.SQL.DAYOFWEEK(h) Set offset=(dow+5)#7 Set startDay=$Piece(h,",",1)-offset Set wtdStart=startDay_",0" Set wtdEnd=h
Set year=+$Extract(ts,1,4) Set mon=+$Extract(ts,6,7) Set mon2=..Pad2(mon) Set firstStr=year_"-"_mon2_"-01 00:00:00" Set mtdStart=$ZDATETIMEH(firstStr,3) Set mtdEnd=h
Kill dayCounts,dayExcluded,wtdCounts,wtdExcluded,mtdCounts,mtdExcluded Set dayTotal=0,wtdTotal=0,mtdTotal=0
Do ..BuildWindowCounts(dayStart,dayEnd,.dayCounts,.dayExcluded,.dayTotal) Do ..BuildWindowCounts(wtdStart,wtdEnd,.wtdCounts,.wtdExcluded,.wtdTotal) Do ..BuildWindowCounts(mtdStart,mtdEnd,.mtdCounts,.mtdExcluded,.mtdTotal)
Set json="{" Set json=json_"""as_of"":"""_..JsonEsc(ts)_"""," Set json=json_"""day_to_date"":"_..MetricToJSON(dayTotal,.dayCounts,.dayExcluded)_"," Set json=json_"""week_to_date"":"_..MetricToJSON(wtdTotal,.wtdCounts,.wtdExcluded)_"," Set json=json_"""month_to_date"":"_..MetricToJSON(mtdTotal,.mtdCounts,.mtdExcluded) Set json=json_"}" Quit json

Method.name: CountWeek
Method.Description: Calendar week containing pAnyTS. Week start = Sunday.
Method.Implementation:
Set h=..ToHorolog(pAnyTS) Set day=$Piece(h,",",1) Set dow=$SYSTEM.SQL.DAYOFWEEK(h) ; 1=Sun..7=Sat
Set startDay=day-(dow-1) Set startH=startDay_",0" Set endH=(startDay+6)_",86399"
Quit ..CountAll(startH,endH)

Method.name: CountWeekMon
Method.Description: Calendar week containing pAnyTS. Week start = Monday.
Method.Implementation:
Set h=..ToHorolog(pAnyTS) Set day=$Piece(h,",",1) Set dow=$SYSTEM.SQL.DAYOFWEEK(h)
Set offset=(dow+5)#7 Set startDay=day-offset Set startH=startDay_",0" Set endH=(startDay+6)_",86399"
Quit ..CountAll(startH,endH)

Method.name: CountMonth
Method.Description: Full calendar month containing pAnyTS (1st -> last day).
Method.Implementation:
Set ts=..NormTS(pAnyTS)
Set year=+$Extract(ts,1,4) Set mon=+$Extract(ts,6,7) Set mon2=..Pad2(mon)
Set firstStr=year_"-"_mon2_"-01 00:00:00" Set firstH=$ZDATETIMEH(firstStr,3)
; next month first day If mon=12 { Set nextYear=year+1 Set nextMon=1 } Else { Set nextYear=year Set nextMon=mon+1 }
Set nextMon2=..Pad2(nextMon) Set nextStr=nextYear_"-"_nextMon2_"-01 00:00:00" Set nextH=$ZDATETIMEH(nextStr,3)
Set endDay=$Piece(nextH,",",1)-1 Set startH=$Piece(firstH,",",1)_",0" Set endH=endDay_",86399"
Quit ..CountAll(startH,endH)

Method.name: PrintRangeRollups
Method.Description: Rollup report for any range: - Monthly totals (YYYY-MM) - Weekly totals (Week Of YYYY-MM-DD Monday start) - Grand total + checks - Shows which namespaces used INDEX vs SQL vs GLOBAL

Method.name: CountOneNamespace
Method.Description: Count one namespace for a window. Uses index when available; falls back to SQL count when index missing; then global scan.

Method.name: CountUsingIndex
CountUsingSQL
Method.Description: SQL fallback count. Returns count and sets pStatus to OK (SQL) or a failure string.

Method.name: CountUsingGlobal
Method.Description: GLOBAL fallback count: scans ^Ens.MessageHeaderD(id) and uses list piece 15 for TimeCreated. Speed-up: early-stop only when TimeCreated appears monotonic by ID.

UDLText.name: T
UDLText.Content: // Window helpers (used by table + JSON summaries)

Method.name: BuildWindowCounts
Method.Implementation:
Kill pCounts, pExcluded Set pTotal=0
Set startTS=..NormTS(pStart) Set endTS=..NormTS(pEnd)
Kill nsList Do ##class(%SYS.Namespace).ListAll(.nsList)
Set ns="" For { Set ns=$Order(nsList(ns)) Quit:ns="" Continue:$Extract(ns,1,1)="%"
Set status="" Set c=..CountOneNamespace(ns,startTS,endTS,.status)
If c>0 { Set pCounts(ns)=c Set pTotal=pTotal+c } Else { If status'="" Set pExcluded(ns)=status } }
Quit

Method.name: MetricToJSON
Method.Implementation: Set json="{" Set json=json_"""total"":"_pTotal_"," Set json=json_"""by_namespace"":"_..JsonObjFromNumericArray(.pCounts)_"," Set json=json_"""excluded"":"_..JsonObjFromStringArray(.pExcluded) Set json=json_"}" Quit json

Method.name: JsonObjFromNumericArray
Method.Implementation: Set json="{" Set key="" Set first=1 For { Set key=$Order(a(key)) Quit:key="" If 'first Set json=json_"," Set first=0 Set json=json_""""_..JsonEsc(key)_""":"_+$Get(a(key)) } Set json=json_"}" Quit json

Method.name: JsonObjFromStringArray
Method.Implementation: Set json="{" Set key="" Set first=1 For { Set key=$Order(a(key)) Quit:key="" If 'first Set json=json_"," Set first=0 Set json=json_""""_..JsonEsc(key)_""":"""_..JsonEsc($Get(a(key)))_"""" } Set json=json_"}" Quit json

Method.name: JsonEsc
Method.Implementation: Set s=$Get(s) Set s=$Replace(s,"\","\\") Set s=$Replace(s,"""","\""") Set s=$Replace(s,$Char(13),"") Set s=$Replace(s,$Char(10),"\n") Quit s

Method.name: RollupFromIndex
Method.Implementation:
Set ts="" For { Set ts=$Order(^Ens.MessageHeaderI("TimeCreated",ts)) Quit:ts=""
Continue:(pStartTS ]] ts) Quit:(ts ]] pEndTS)
Set cntAtTs=0 Set id="" For { Set id=$Order(^Ens.MessageHeaderI("TimeCreated",ts,id)) Quit:id="" Set cntAtTs=cntAtTs+1 } Continue:cntAtTs=0
Set monKey=$Extract(ts,1,7) Set monthCounts(monKey)=$Get(monthCounts(monKey))+cntAtTs
Set h=$ZDATETIMEH(ts,3) Set day=$Piece(h,",",1) Set dow=$SYSTEM.SQL.DAYOFWEEK(h) Set offset=(dow+5)#7 Set wkStartDay=day-offset Set wkKey=$ZDATE(wkStartDay,3)
Set weekCounts(wkKey)=$Get(weekCounts(wkKey))+cntAtTs Set grandTotal=grandTotal+cntAtTs } Quit

Method.name: RollupFromSQL
Method.Description: SQL rollup for unindexed namespaces (fast when permitted). Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

Method.name: RollupFromGlobal
Method.Description: GLOBAL rollup fallback (slow but works when SQL is blocked and no index). Speed-up: early-stop only when TimeCreated appears monotonic by ID. Returns 1 on success (saw at least one tc), 0 if it can’t find usable TimeCreated values.
Method.Implementation:
Set ok=0 Set id="" Set prevTC="" Set monotonic=1 Set seenInOrAfterStart=0
For { Set id=$Order(^Ens.MessageHeaderD(id)) Quit:id=""
Set row=$Get(^Ens.MessageHeaderD(id)) Continue:row=""
Set tc=$ListGet(row,15) Continue:tc=""
Set ok=1
; detect non-monotonicity If prevTC'="" { If (prevTC ]] tc) Set monotonic=0 } Set prevTC=tc
; before start If (pStartTS ]] tc) Continue Set seenInOrAfterStart=1
; after end If (tc ]] pEndTS) { If seenInOrAfterStart, monotonic { Quit } Else { Continue } }
; in range: bucket Set monKey=$Extract(tc,1,7) Set monthCounts(monKey)=$Get(monthCounts(monKey))+1
Set h=$ZDATETIMEH(tc,3) Set day=$Piece(h,",",1) Set dow=$SYSTEM.SQL.DAYOFWEEK(h) Set offset=(dow+5)#7 Set wkStartDay=day-offset Set wkKey=$ZDATE(wkStartDay,3)
Set weekCounts(wkKey)=$Get(weekCounts(wkKey))+1 Set grandTotal=grandTotal+1 }
Quit ok

Method.name: NormTS
Method.Description: Normalize input timestamp to the string format used by TimeCreated index. If passed $H, convert using $ZDATETIME(h,3).
Method.Implementation: If ($Get(pTS)[",") Quit $ZDATETIME(pTS,3) Quit $Get(pTS)

Method.name: ToHorolog
Method.Description: Convert input (either $H or timestamp string) to $H.
Method.Implementation: If ($Get(pTS)[",") Quit pTS Quit $ZDATETIMEH(pTS,3)

Method.name: Pad2
Method.Implementation: Quit $Select(pN<10:"0"_pN,1:""_pN)
